hints.title: Undirected Connections
hints.text: Friendships represent bidirectional connections between pairs of platform members.

hints.title: Union Symmetry
hints.text: Combine both directional perspectives using a union so every connection is registered for each individual participant.

hints.title: Popularity Ratio
hints.text: Count the unique individuals platform-wide in one aggregate, then group by participant to compute their connection ratio rounded to two decimal places.

hints.title: Bidirectional SQL Aggregation
hints.text:
```mysql
WITH CombinedFriends AS (
    SELECT user1, user2 FROM Friends
    UNION
    SELECT user2 AS user1, user1 AS user2 FROM Friends
),
TotalUsers AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user1) AS cnt FROM CombinedFriends
)
SELECT 
    cf.user1,
    ROUND(COUNT(cf.user2) * 100.0 / (SELECT cnt FROM TotalUsers), 2) AS percentage_popularity
FROM CombinedFriends cf
GROUP BY cf.user1
ORDER BY cf.user1 ASC;
```

complexity.time: O(N log N) for union distinct and sorting
complexity.notes: Symmetric union followed by aggregation yields friend counts.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Querying friendship pairs without symmetrizing misses reverse relationships.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Combined friendship relation takes linear space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Correctly normalizes undirected relations using UNION and applies scalar aggregation.

WITH CombinedFriends AS (
    SELECT user1, user2 FROM Friends
    UNION
    SELECT user2 AS user1, user1 AS user2 FROM Friends
),
TotalUsers AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user1) AS cnt FROM CombinedFriends
)
SELECT 
    cf.user1,
    ROUND(COUNT(cf.user2) * 100.0 / (SELECT cnt FROM TotalUsers), 2) AS percentage_popularity
FROM CombinedFriends cf
GROUP BY cf.user1
ORDER BY cf.user1 ASC;

WITH CombinedFriends AS (
    SELECT user1, user2 FROM Friends
    UNION
    SELECT user2 AS user1, user1 AS user2 FROM Friends
),
TotalUsers AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user1)::numeric AS cnt FROM CombinedFriends
)
SELECT 
    cf.user1,
    ROUND(COUNT(cf.user2) * 100.0 / (SELECT cnt FROM TotalUsers), 2) AS percentage_popularity
FROM CombinedFriends cf
GROUP BY cf.user1
ORDER BY cf.user1 ASC;
